targetedBoundaryFollowup.scope: Partial SETUP/SETBC and geometry-update readings following the frozen leading-edge failure audit. Complete boundary/global-equation parity and contour-update ordering remain unverified.

coupledWakeMotionAudit.scope: NCALC on current physical banks; UPDATE/NEWDIS displaced material wall; SETBC pressure and gap conditions. Corrected bare-TE normal chart. Independent-bank versus reduced-centerline equivalence remains unproven. No original code executed.

independentWakeBankAudit.scope: Independent physical bank motion and exact nonlinear normal-gap derivative reconstructed; active SETBC approximate increment coefficients are not copied as exact nonlinear parity. Page 264 SMOVE trigger reinspected. Controlled and default coupled equation roots verified; final default LE quad and physical accuracy remain open. No original code executed.

stagnationCutAudit.scope: Reinspected inlet tangential update and normal directions; no new mismatch in the inspected operations. Complete boundary/global-equation parity remains unproven. Same-root redistribution and conservative restart retain the flap LE defect; paired stagnation refinement exposes a first-wake-volume crossing before maintenance. No original code executed.

wakeArcInitializationAudit.scope: INIT assigns wake XI from initialized blade length and supplied wake-length fractions; NEWDIS displaces material walls through TE. Current physical wake-arc convention is not proven equivalent; no wake-coordinate equation changed. Physical streamfunction refinement is our reconstruction, not ISES/MSES listing parity. No original code executed.

pressureCorrectionAudit.scope: Visual reinspection confirms full node-to-node vectors, signed curvature cross products, side/section averages, and the active auxiliary pressure coefficient used by the current cell.
